question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The study of the human mind
solution:
The correct answer is '**Psychology**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option for the given group of words is: **Psychology**.
 
• **Psychology** (English): The scientific study of the human mind and behavior. [मनोविज्ञान (Hindi): मन और व्यवहार की वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन]
 
• Explanation:
 
 
• **Psychology** is the study of the human mind, including thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.
 
• **Microbiology** (option 2) is the study of microorganisms.
 
• **Epidemiology** (option 3) is the study of the distribution and determinants of health-related states or events in populations.
 
• **Anthropology** (option 4) is the study of human societies and cultures.
 
 
 
• ***Example sentence:**__** **Understanding human behavior is a central focus of **psychology**.*
